relevance_note: Review whose supplementary Table S1 gives individual-level data (age of onset, sex, variant, manifestations, treatment) for each of 89 HA20 patients: 'Table S1. Clinical characteristics of patients with HA20.'
method_note: Literature review; individual-level data appear only in supplementary Table S1 (PDF converted to fixed-width text, 89 rows). Labels are the Table S1 'Patient' column numbers (1-89) verbatim; family labels are the 'Family' column numbers; the '(Ref.)' numbers refer to the reference list printed under Table S1 (not the main-text references) and are recorded in source_reference_in_review. A Python script in my scratch directory parsed each Table S1 row (patient number, AOS, gender, the ten +/- columns) and cut the Other manifestations / Initial diagnosis / Treatment columns at the header positions; I checked the parsed output against the table row by row. Features from the free-text columns were read by me; a script only located their exact text. Symbols: '+' read as present (observed). Neither the legend nor the text defines '-', so '-' cells are not reported and no 'excluded' rows were made; '/' is treated as empty. No group statements were used (statements about the OTU/ZnF groups name no individuals, and group membership is not printed per patient). Spans: row segment from the patient number through the cell. For patients whose row has no family cell (merged-cell layout, including rows after page breaks: 20-21 under family 6, 32-34 under family 12, 76 under family 33), the family/variant cell of the family's first row is quoted with the patient's own row segment. Cells wrapped across lines are quoted as fragments; for the treatments of patients 43 and 59, adjacent fragments are joined in contiguous multi-line spans that include intervening whitespace and other-column text. AOS is in years (header 'AOS (y)'). ISO: whole years as PnY; exact months where the decimal equals whole months (0.5, 0.75, 1.25, 3.5); otherwise decimal years (e.g. P0.17Y) to avoid rounding. AOS is blank for patients 36, 48, 70, 71, 72, 75, 86 and 89. Initial diagnosis column: syndromic diagnoses that HA20 later replaced (BD, intestinal BD, JIA, RA, early-onset RA, SLE, CD, FMF, psoriatic arthritis, adult-onset Still's disease, undifferentiated connective tissue disease, autoimmune lymphoproliferative syndrome undefined, rheumatic fever, PFAPA-like) are not recorded as features. Organ-specific findings in that column are recorded as observed (e.g. HD = Hashimoto disease, autoimmune thyroiditis, autoimmune thyroid disease, Graves' disease, lupus nephritis, IgA vasculitis, Henoch Schonlein purpura, cutaneous vasculitis, psoriasis, cirrhosis, stomatitis). Items repeating the Other manifestations column are not duplicated. Checklist: the Ocular, MSD and AITD columns are broader than 'uveitis or other ocular inflammation', 'arthritis or arthralgia' and 'autoimmune thyroiditis', so they are not mapped. Thyroiditis is observed only for HD or 'Autoimmune thyroiditis'. Atrophic gastritis maps to GI inflammation; HSP and IgA vasculitis map to vasculitis; idiopathic thrombocytopenic purpura maps to cytopenia (autoimmune). Unqualified 'cytopenia' (patient 46), craniopharyngioma, pervasive developmental disorder, and pericardial effusion/ascites are not mapped. RRTI, recurrent urinary tract infections and repeated genital HSV infections map to recurrent infections. Variants: protein strings exactly as printed in Table S1, including spaces ('p. Arg 87*') and 'p. Asn98Thrfs25' with no asterisk (Table S2 prints 'p.Asn98Thrfs*25'). Gene, heterozygosity and 'disease-causing' come from main-text statements covering all 89 patients. The variant class is not stated per variant, except for the exon 2-3 deletion. Contradictions: Table 1 gives oral ulcers 62/89, genital ulcers 32/89 and skin lesion 34/89, but Table S1 '+' counts are 67, 37 and 35. RF 37, ocular 6, vasculitis 5, GI 36, MSD 30, AITD 17, RRTI 8 and sex 36 M / 53 F all match. Table S2 gives p.Lys91* in 4/89, but Table S1 lists 8 patients (families 22 and 33); it gives p.Gln370Argfs*16 in 5/89, but Table S1 lists only patient 58. Family numbers skip 31 and 32 (39 families). The text says 93 cases were collected and 4 excluded for additional mutations; cohort_size_as_stated is the 89 included. The methods exclude patients with additional gene mutations, yet the title of Table S1 ref. 14 mentions IL36RN and TNFAIP3 variants; Table S1 attributes no other-gene variant to patients 70-72, so none is recorded.
